metadata.title: feat(plugins): add multi-tenancy support with per-server plugin managers
metadata.author: cafalchio

description:
## 🔗 Related Issue
Closes #3801

---

## 📝 Summary

Previously the gateway had a single global `PluginManager` singleton initialized at startup.
This PR replaces it with a `TenantPluginManagerFactory` that creates and caches isolated
`TenantPluginManager` instances per virtual server, enabling each tenant to have independent
plugin configurations, priorities, and modes.

### Architecture

```
Before
──────
startup
  └─ TenantPluginManager (singleton, Borg shared state)
       └─ all requests share one config

After
─────
get_plugin_manager(context_id)              # async, called per-request
  └─ TenantPluginManagerFactory (global singleton)
       ├─ _managers["__global__"]          # global / fallback 
       ├─ _managers["server-abc"]          # per-tenant 
       └─ _managers["server-xyz"]
             └─ merged config = base YAML ⊕ tenant overrides
```


**Key flows:**

- `get_plugin_manager(context_id)` — lazy-creates and caches a manager for `context_id`.
  Uses a double-checked lock pattern: fast path is a plain dict read; slow path holds
  the `asyncio.Lock` only during the final cache insert, so concurrent lookups for
  different servers never block each other.
- `shutdown_plugin_manager_factory()` — called from lifespan teardown; shuts down all
  cached managers and clears the factory reference.
- `TenantPluginManager._merge_tenant_config(context_id)` — overlays per-server plugin
  overrides (config, mode, priority) from `_tenant_configs` onto the base YAML config.
- `BaseService._get_plugin_manager(context_id)` — single entry point for all services
  (tool, resource, prompt); falls back to an injected `_plugin_manager` mock in tests.

### Changed components

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `plugins/framework/manager.py` | Add `TenantPluginManager`, `TenantPluginManagerFactory`; `_DEFAULT_CONTEXT_ID` sentinel; fix Borg init ordering bug |
| `plugins/framework/__init__.py` | Replace `_plugin_manager` singleton + `set_plugin_manager` with async `get_plugin_manager(context_id)` and `shutdown_plugin_manager_factory` |
| `mcpgateway/main.py` | Remove startup-time singleton init; resolve manager lazily at request time; call `shutdown_plugin_manager_factory()` on teardown |
| `mcpgateway/services/base_service.py` | Add `_get_plugin_manager(context_id)` shared helper |
| `mcpgateway/services/{tool,resource,prompt}_service.py` | Use `_get_plugin_manager` instead of module-level import |
| `mcpgateway/middleware/rbac.py` | Minor import cleanup |
| `plugins/config.yaml` | Updated plugin config |
| `tests/` | Updated to inject `_plugin_manager` mock via instance attribute |

## 📓 Notes

Backward compatibility:
    The global ``__global__`` context uses ``PluginManager`` with ``singleton=True``
    (Borg shared state) to preserve backward-compatible behaviour for deployments that
    do not use virtual-server tenancy.  Per-server managers created by
    ``TenantPluginManagerFactory`` use ``TenantPluginManager`` (Borg disabled) so each
    has fully independent state.

Concurrency safety:
    ``TenantPluginManagerFactory.get_manager`` uses a task-based double-checked pattern.
    The fast path (dict read inside the lock) is safe in asyncio's single-threaded model.
    The slow path creates a single ``asyncio.Task`` per ``context_id`` and stores it in
    ``_inflight`` while the lock is held, so only one build task is ever started for a
    given context.  Concurrent callers waiting on the same ``context_id`` all await the
    same task.  Once the task completes, ``_build_manager`` stores the result in
    ``_managers`` under the lock, and ``get_manager`` re-checks the cache before
    returning so that any replacement triggered by ``reload_tenant`` is honoured.

commits.message:
add per-context plugin manager with TenantPluginManagerFactory

Introduce context-scoped plugin isolation via a new TenantPluginManagerFactory
singleton. Each virtual server/tenant receives its own TenantPluginManager with
an independently merged plugin config, while the __global__ manager continues to
serve non-context-aware call sites.

- Add TenantPluginManager (disables Borg state sharing) and
  TenantPluginManagerFactory (async-safe, deduplicating cache/factory)
- Update framework __init__ accessors: init_plugin_manager_factory(),
  get_plugin_manager(server_id), shutdown/reset helpers
- Wire services (tool, prompt, resource, classification) to pass server_id
  when resolving plugin managers
- Update main.py lifespan to initialize factory eagerly at startup
- Add PluginConfigOverride model and shallow config merge logic
- Add architecture doc and 756-line test suite for tenant-scoped plugin execution
